questions.stem: If $$\int_0^{2} f(x)\,dx = 5$$ and $$\int_0^{5} f(x)\,dx = 3$$, what is $$\int_{2}^{5} \left(4f(x) + 4\right)dx$$?

questions.stem: What is $$\lim_{x \to \infty} \frac{4x^{2} - 8}{2x^{2} + 7}$$?

questions.stem: A particle moves along the x-axis so that its position at time $$t \geq 0$$ is $$x(t) = t^{3} - 9t^{2} + 15t$$. At what times is the particle at rest?

questions.stem: If $$f(x) = \csc x$$, what is $$f'\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)$$?

questions.stem: A farmer has 88 meters of fencing to enclose a rectangular field along a straight river. No fence is needed along the river. What is the largest possible area of the field, in square meters?

questions.stem: The function $$g$$ is defined by $$g(x) = \frac{\sin(2x)}{e^{3x} - 1}$$ for $$x \neq 0$$. For what value of $$g(0)$$ is $$g$$ continuous at $$x = 0$$?
